posts.name: Christopher
posts.cooked:
Ok, people. I don’t know if you’re familiar with the awesome product Gaming Paper, but it makes my life significantly better, and I was thrilled to get to meet and hang out with Erik Bauer, the creator of Gaming Paper, at Gen Con this year! Very cool guy - all the Gaming Paper folks were great, really. However! They are now working on making some TOTALLY AWESOME gift wrap, which is good, as the vast majority of gift wrap I buy falls into the, “eh, this is good enough, and not terribly offensive to my eyes.” THIS STUFF is awesome. Seriously awesome. I mean, come on - who DOESN’T want their gifts wrapped in Elder Signs and Elder Gods? Right? RIGHT?!

So, go check out their Kickstarter - it only had a couple of days left, and it would be really awesome to see this cool and fun project funded! Really, I’m posting this for entirely selfish reasons. I want to buy Cthulhu wrapping paper! If it doesn’t get funded, my pledge doesn’t go through, and I don’t get my precious rolls of sweet, terrifying gift wrap! Any takers?
